name: Vegetarian Burrito Bowl with Spanish Rice, Beans, Cheese, Guacamole & Salsa (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Rinse the rice under cold, running water.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place half in a medium bowl and set aside for the pico de gallo.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add rice, remaining onion, and spices; cook, stirring constantly, until onions are soft and rice is golden and toasted (you should hear a slight sizzle and pop from the rice), about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp chili powder
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Add water, tomato sauce, corn, and salt to the pot, then stir to combine. Bring to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover pot, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups water
1 (8 fl oz) can tomato sauce
1 cup frozen corn
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lime
1 jalapeño pepper
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice lime into the bowl with the reserved onion.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomatoes. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl, along with salt, and stir to combine the pico de gallo. Set aside.
Drain and rinse beans. Set aside to drain further.
When the rice is done, add beans to the pot and stir to combine. Transfer rice and beans to a large baking sheet pan, spread out in an even layer, and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes.

When the rice and beans are cool, divide between the food storage containers along with pico de gallo, cheese, and guacamole cups. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Remove guacamole cups, heat in an oven or microwave, and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded
4 (2 oz) cup guacamole
